global_caption: The video contains 9 shots and is a short dramatic piece in the realistic mystery treasure-hunt genre. It uses neutral tones and cool nighttime realistic lighting, primarily unified by desk lamps in offices, cold white lights in hospitals, and localized blue-gold mystical glows. The
shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in, using a medium shot at eye level. The composition places an old desk in the foreground, with tall cabinets and blinds in the background. Shallow depth of field focuses on the hands and face of a young female archivist. The night office is lit by a warm white desk lamp and faint cold light from outside. The paper edges are aged, and she leans forward flipping through files, her fingers brushing yellowed pages. The camera slowly pushes in, amplifying the The
shot2: Shot 2 cuts hard from the previous shot, switching to a close-up overhead view. The background is blurred, leaving only the outline of her chin and fingertips. The desk lamp remains steady. Beneath the coffee stain, a glowing map gradually emerges. The paper shifts from dull to revealing fine cold blue lines. The camera makes a slight tilt adjustment to emphasize the moment of discovery.
shot3: Shot 3 transitions via a dissolve along the map lines to a corner of a café, using a close-up at eye level. A half-empty coffee cup and open notepad occupy the foreground, while streetlights reflected in glass fragment the background. Focus rests on the table between the young female archivist and an older male teacher, both Black explorers, who quietly compare files, hand-drawn maps, and hospital floor plans. The teacher points with his pen tip to an old classroom number, and the archivist nods in response. Their movements are brief and synchronized. Ambient lighting remains neutral and cool. Coffee machine steam and gentle clinking of cups and saucers are layered in the background. The camera slowly pans sideways, linking their expressions and clue papers into a continuous visual chain.
shot4: Shot 4 cuts hard into an empty classroom, using a wide shot at eye level. The lectern is centered for stable composition, with rows of empty desks creating depth that draws the eye forward. Cold moonlight streams in from high windows, casting shadows beneath the lectern. They approach one after another. The older male teacher crouches to feel the edge of a hidden compartment, while the young archivist raises her phone to provide light. When the compartment opens, it reveals an old copper compass. The object emerges from darkness with a dull metallic texture. The camera slowly follows from the doorway, tilting down slightly as the compartment opens, reinforcing the progression of “找到第一件关键道具”.
shot5: Shot 5 cuts hard from the previous shot, shifting to a close-up with slight upward angle. The compass dominates the foreground, with both faces positioned in the same focal plane in the background. Side window light and phone illumination remain dominant. A faint blue pattern resembling an old door frame or rune briefly appears on the wall. Both characters inhale sharply. The archivist instinctively steps back half a pace, while the teacher reaches out to stabilize the compass. The camera performs a small circular movement around the compass, creating a sense of spatial anomaly while maintaining realistic scale.
shot6: Shot 6 transitions via a quick cut to a hospital corridor, using a medium tracking shot at eye level. The long corridor creates strong perspective lines. Occasional silhouettes of broken beds pass in the foreground, while partially open doors and darkness at the end appear in the background. The cold white ceiling lights flicker intermittently. The compass needle steadily points forward. The two explorers crouch and walk quickly, their clothing and papers fluttering slightly with motion. The archivist quietly repeats directions, and the teacher responds with shorter Chinese phrases for confirmation. The camera uses a stabilizer-style close-follow, enhancing the stealthy atmosphere.
shot7: Shot 7 cuts hard to the archive room, using a medium-close overhead shot slightly off-center. A metal cabinet occupies most of the frame. Dusty labels and rusted handles appear in the foreground, while darkness toward the rear area is visible in the background. The ceiling light remains cold white practical lighting. Guided by the compass, the two work together to move the heavy cabinet. Metal scrapes loudly yet mutedly across the floor. As the cabinet shifts, a narrow door leading to the kitchen storage area is revealed. The teacher first ducks in, followed closely by the archivist. The camera first tilts down slightly, then smoothly pans right, fully revealing “隐藏入口”.
shot8: Shot 8 enters the kitchen storage area via action match cut, using a close-up at eye level. Cold white kitchen lighting falls directly from above, with metal shelves and old wooden crates forming front-to-back layers. The compass is placed atop the hidden chest lock. Blue-gold light slowly seeps from the lock seam, gradually illuminating their faces. Light inside expands from a narrow slit into a soft yet mysterious glow. Their pupils clearly reflect blue-gold hues. The The camera first slowly pushes to the lock, then gently lifts to capture their faces illuminated by the strange light, completing the emotional leap from “开启” to “见证”.
shot9: Shot 9 connects with the previous shot via a fade-in, becoming a close-up tight shot at eye level. Composition centers on two hands and the gemstone, with the background kitchen shelves completely blurred, leaving only the halo of cold white light and residual glow from the chest. Lighting remains dominated by practical cold white light combined with the gemstone’s own blue-gold microglow. They first look at each other, then return their gaze to the gem. The camera performs an extremely slow push-in until it stops within the range of the gem and the lower halves of their faces, concluding the story in quiet, reserved, solemn secrecy.
